title: Price Levels और Price List
intro:
भाग 4 — Trading का पूरा चक्र

कुल Problems: 3 │ 🟢 1 🟡 1 🔴 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

Customer-वर्ग के अनुसार अलग Rate और Discount Slab लगाना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

F11: Use Multiple Price Levels = Yes

Price Level बनाएँ और Stock Item की Price List भरें

Party में Price Level जोड़ें

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Price List की Effective Date भूलना

Quantity Slab Overlap करना

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

F11 में 'Use Multiple Price Levels' व 'Enable Discount Column in Invoices' चालू करें। Price Level बनाने के बाद हर Stock Item की Price List बनाएँ; Price Revision के लिए नई Effective Date से Price List दोबारा भरें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Create the Price Levels and Price Lists in Tally Prime, pass the Sales Vouchers with the correct Price Level and verify the invoice amounts and stock.
guide:
Price Levels और Price List

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Price Level की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Use Multiple Price Levels = Yes और Enable Discount Column in Invoices = Yes।
  • Gateway → Create → Price Level: हर Level का नाम बनाएँ (जैसे Retailer, Wholesaler)।
  • हर Level के लिए Stock Item की Price List भरें: Applicable From (तारीख़), Quantity Slab (From–Less Than), Rate और Discount %।
  • Party Ledger में उसका Price Level चुनें।
  • Sales Voucher (F8): Party चुनते ही उसका Price Level लग जाता है; Rate/Discount अपने-आप भरते हैं।
  • Price बदलना हो तो नई Effective Date से Price List दोबारा भरें (पुरानी तारीख़ के Voucher पर असर नहीं पड़ता)।
याद रखें

Price List की Effective Date भूलने पर नया Rate पुराने Vouchers में भी चढ़ सकता है।

Quantity Slab Overlap न करें।

Party का Level बदलने के बाद अगले Voucher से नया Rate लगता है।

problems.title: Kirana Supplier — Two Price Levels with Price Revision
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Opening Stock: Sugar 1,000 Kg @ ₹38 (cost)
  • 1st April — Price Levels & Price List for Sugar: Retailer Level = ₹45/Kg; Wholesaler Level = ₹42/Kg (no discount on either)
  • 2nd April — Sold to Gupta Kirana (Retailer Level): 40 Kg Sugar. Sold to Bansal Traders (Wholesaler Level): 200 Kg Sugar
  • 1st May — Price Revision: increase both levels by ₹2/Kg
  • 2nd May — Sold to Gupta Kirana (Retailer): 10 Kg. Sold to Bansal Traders (Wholesaler): 100 Kg
problems.hint:
• Opening Stock: Sugar 1,000 Kg @ ₹38 (Cost)।
  • 1 Apr: Price Levels — Retailer = ₹45/Kg; Wholesaler = ₹42/Kg (कोई Discount नहीं)।
  • 2 Apr: Sales Gupta Kirana (Retailer) 40 Kg; Bansal Traders (Wholesaler) 200 Kg।
  • 1 May: Price Revision — दोनों Levels में ₹2/Kg बढ़ाएँ (नई Effective Date 1 May): Retailer 47; Wholesaler 44।
  • 2 May: Sales Gupta Kirana 10 Kg; Bansal Traders 100 Kg।

problems.title: Reliance Fresh — Card Holder vs Customer Price List
problems.q:
🟡 Intermediate

Reliance Card Holder को सभी Items पर 2% Discount मिलता है; सामान्य Customer को 0% Discount। Items पर कोई Quantity Limit नहीं है।

  • 1st October — Opening Stock (Toothpaste) with Cost / Selling Price per Pcs: Close Up 150g — 150 Pcs (₹42 / ₹52); Pepsodent 150g — 100 Pcs (₹44 / ₹50); DantKanti 100g — 150 Pcs (₹48 / ₹56); Babool 150g — 80 Pcs (₹41 / ₹48); Colgate Max Gel 150g — 100 Pcs (₹49 / ₹58)
  • 2nd October — Sold to Reliance Card Holders: Vinay (Inv. 1) — DantKanti 5 Pcs; Priya (Inv. 2) — Colgate Max Gel 3 Pcs
  • 2nd October — Sold to Customers (no card): Sunil (Inv. 3) — Close Up 7, Pepsodent 5, DantKanti 4; Himanshu (Inv. 4) — Pepsodent 6, Colgate Max Gel 8
  • 1st November — Price Revision: decrease Selling Price of all Toothpaste items by ₹2 per Pcs
  • 2nd November — Sold to Vikram (no card, Inv. 5): Close Up 3 Pcs, Pepsodent 2 Pcs
problems.hint:
• दो Price Levels: "Reliance Card Holder" (Discount 2%) और "Customer" (Discount 0%)। कोई Qty Limit नहीं।
  • Opening Stock (1 Oct) और Selling Price नीचे Table में; Price List में वही Selling Price भरें।
  • 1 Nov से Selling Price ₹2 घटाएँ (Close Up 50, Pepsodent 48, बाकी इसी तरह) — नई Effective Date 1 Nov।

problems.title: ABC Computers, Varanasi — Quantity Slabs, GST  &  Payment Modes
problems.q:
🔴 Expert

सभी Parties उत्तर प्रदेश में हैं — GST 18% (CGST 9% + SGST 9%)। Quantity Slabs: 1–20, 21–50, 51–75, 75 से ऊपर।

  • 1st April — Opening Stock (Standard Rate, GST 18%): Sony LED — 300 Nos @ ₹8,500; HP LED — 250 Nos @ ₹16,000; HP Laptop — 250 Nos @ ₹25,000
  • 1st April — Price Level 'Old Customers' (Rate ₹8,500 / ₹16,000 / ₹25,000 fixed; Discount by slab): Sony LED 2% | 4% | 6% | 7%; HP LED 3% | 5% | 6% | 8%; HP Laptop Nil | 2% | 3% | 4%
  • 1st April — Price Level 'New Customers' (No Discount; Rate by slab): Sony LED ₹8,500 | ₹8,400 | ₹8,200 | ₹8,000; HP LED ₹16,000 | ₹15,800 | ₹15,600 | ₹15,400; HP Laptop ₹25,000 | ₹24,600 | ₹24,400 | ₹24,200
  • 1st April — Customers: Sumit Computers & Sweta Computers (Old, Registered); Jwala Computers (New, Registered); Om Sai Computers (New, Unregistered)
  • 1st May — Sales #1 Sumit Computers (Cash): Sony 18, HP LED 25, HP Laptop 80. Sales #2 Jwala Computers (Bank-NEFT): Sony 35, HP LED 60, HP Laptop 10
  • 1st May — Sales #3 Sweta Computers (UPI): Sony 70, HP LED 15, HP Laptop 45. Sales #4 Om Sai Computers (Credit): Sony 100, HP LED 80, HP Laptop 55
